rate.notes: Printed '0.20 basis point * Trade Value' for monthly trade value up to USD 1,000,000,000 (then 0.15, 0.10, 0.08 basis point), with '1 basis point=0.0001': 0.00002 of the value, recorded as 0.002% (pct_of_trade, as at Interactive Israel). The USD 2.00 minimum is in min. 'Commissions for currency trades are calculated off the trade value and then converted and charged to the base currency of the account.' 'All exchange and regulatory fees included.' On the rate: 'IBKR passes through the prices that it receives and charges a separate low commission. We do this in the interest of providing a transparent pricing structure instead of marking up our quotes' and, in the page's heading, 'Transparent low commissions with no mark-ups on quotes' (both re-read on the live page 2026-11-06); the market's own bid and ask remain. No `spread` is recorded: the page prints no ceiling on a spread of the kind the Israeli price lists print ('עד 0.7% משער ההמרה'), it says the quotes are passed on unmarked, so no spread beyond the market's is priced (F-13). Commissions Spot Currencies, note on the auto currency conversion service
source.quote: IB does not separately charge a commission on these auto-conversion trades

rate.notes: 'Please note that IB does not separately charge a commission on these auto-conversion trades': no commission; the markup on the rate is recorded in `spread` with no value, so it is not priced (D65), and left_out says so (2026-11-12): the conversion part of this house's price is zero whenever it converts this way. A cash account converts by itself when it buys in a currency it does not hold: 'If Client incurs an obligation in a cash (or IRA) account in a currency as a result of a purchase denominated in such currency (the "Purchase Currency"), and if insufficient funds exist in the account in that currency, IBKR will automatically convert the necessary amount of Client's long currency balance(s) to the required amount of the Purchase Currency' (Interactive Brokers LLC client agreement, form 3203, s.30C, p.15, library b866cea6e6d76d50; Interactive Brokers Ireland, form 4750, 'Automatic Currency Conversion Functionality of CASH Accounts', p.23, library 8344401953b5e137, in the same words), so shekels held in the account pay for a fund quoted in dollars with no conversion order of the client's own. The clause speaks of a purchase: a sale's proceeds are converted by a spot order (interactive-brokers-fx-spot). A margin account is not covered by the clause.

source.title: Commissions Spot Currencies, note on the auto currency conversion service
source.quote: typically add or subtract (at its discretion) 0.03% to the exchange rate

spread.notes: Not limited by the documents (D56, D65): 'For currency trades executed under the auto currency conversion service, IB will typically add or subtract (at its discretion) 0.03% to the exchange rate that would otherwise apply' (re-read 2026-11-10), and the client agreement (form 3203, s.30C) says the automatic conversion rate 'may be adjusted from the rate that otherwise would apply to compensate for differences between the agreed settlement cycle for the trade and the standard settlement cycle for that currency pair'. 0.03% is the figure printed as typical, not a ceiling, so it is not priced, as the conversion inside Interactive Israel's recurring plan is not (interactive-israel-fx-recurring-plan).
